acceptanceCriteria: The comment in .github/testconfine/scopes.go names the current reader path (internal/gateselect/readscopes.go) or no stale path; the change carries AFP-V0-016 owner consent for .github/.
body: Residual from the V1-1399 lane (PR #929, head 777303913, base 321a66f71). The read-scope reader moved to internal/gateselect/readscopes.go, but the comment in .github/testconfine/scopes.go still names tools/gate-affected-select/readscopes.go. The file is owner-protected (.github/, AFP-V0-016), so the lane left it. Expected: the comment names the current path. Actual: a stale path.
title: .github/testconfine/scopes.go comment names stale tools/gate-affected-select/readscopes.go
